description: List a VibeMap project's access-control rules: table-level rules (per persona/role, with can_select/insert/update/delete and structured op_conditions predicates like "own rows only") and page-level rules (can_view/create_content/edit/delete with predicates), plus an advisory reconciliation summary flagging page↔table drift. Use this to generate correct RLS policies and route/UI authorization — the atomic blueprint only carries page-level conditions, so call this for table-level (RLS) access control.
name: vibemap_list_access_rules
